## Checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing and `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] No new third-party dependencies (stdlib-only invariant)
- [ ] Report contract unchanged (JSON shape, exit codes, flags, SARIF) — or a major bump is intended
- [ ] Tests added/updated for the behavior change
- [ ] Docs/README updated if user-facing
